title: When the Playlist Breaks
author: Gideon Vasquez
blurb: Bram Crane, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
